data.name: Sabitah
data.gender_notes: Sabitah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'S-B-T' which means to press, to put under pressure, to stabilize, Sabitah is a name that symbolizes stability, steadfastness, and constancy. It is a name given to a child born under the belief that she will grow up to be a strong and reliable individual. The name Sabitah carries the meaning “Stable, steadfast” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Sabitah usually hope their child will grow to embody stable, steadfast and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the spiritual attribute of steadfastness, and the ability to remain grounded and focused on one's spiritual path despite external distractions and challenges.
data.etymology: Sabitah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Stable, steadfast.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sabitah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
